context_for_next_testing_agent: iter48 UI flows all verified end-to-end. One minor backend CSRF edge case on public /api/careers/*/apply (returns 403 when request carries a stale session cookie). When testing cross-role flows via playwright, use SEPARATE browser_automation invocations per role (page.context.clear_cookies+sessionStorage.clear is unreliable - stale AuthContext/httpOnly cookie carried over in a single session). Public /apply endpoint works correctly in true logged-out contexts.
rca of the issue: CSRF-on-public-endpoint: SaloneHCM CSRF middleware likely applies to all state-changing requests when an access_token cookie is detected. For public /api/careers/* namespace it should skip CSRF enforcement regardless of cookie presence (unauth endpoints). Fix: whitelist /api/careers/* in CSRF middleware OR instruct middleware to only enforce CSRF on cookie-authed endpoints where the user is actually using session (public endpoints should not consult the cookie).
